newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Employees Fund buys privatised state salt firm.
newsitem.headline: Employees Fund buys privatised state salt firm.

text.p: Employees Trust Fund (ETF) said on Friday it had bought Lanka Salt Ltd, which was privatised by the Sri Lanka government.
"We formally took over the company today," said Denzil Gunaratne, chairman of ETF told Reuters.
The purchase price was 452 million rupees ($8 million).
Lanka Salt, the larger of the two local salt producers, is situated in Hambantota in the deep south. The other is in Puttalam north of Colombo.

Sri Lanka is restructuring or privatising loss making and badly run public enterprises, under an ambitious programme which includes getting private management into the country's national carrier and telecommunications operator.
Sri Lanka has advertised the sale of a 35 percent stake and management in Sri Lanka Telecom, and a 40 percent stake and management of Air Lanka.
